CVE-2026-57432.title: perl: Perl: Information disclosure via integer overflow in pack/unpack operations
CVE-2026-57432.description: A flaw was found in Perl. An integer overflow vulnerability in the `S_measure_struct` function, specifically when handling `pack` and `unpack` templates with large repeat counts, can lead to an out-of-bounds heap read. This allows an attacker, by providing a specially crafted template, to read sensitive information from memory beyond the intended buffer. This could result in the disclosure of confidential data.
